title: Agent state in the Sessions panel: Working / Needs you / Idle badges from provider hooks
body:
Implement docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-25-agent-state.md against docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-25-agent-state-design.md. The spec wins on any conflict. No code exists yet (no src/agent_state.rs).

Goal: show working / needs you / idle (plus a done marker) for Claude, Codex and Grok Sessions in the Sessions panel, driven by provider lifecycle hooks. The ONE existing naming hook (foreman title-event --agent X) is installed on a few more events, with --event <Name> baked into each handler. The helper sends the existing TitlePromptEvent with a new hook_event field over the existing pipe and channel; prompt becomes optional and rides only on a main agent UserPromptSubmit. The GUI applies every event to a pure AgentStateSlot on the matching Session (same project + terminal + icon match naming already uses) and starts naming only when prompt is present. The panel reads a badge from the slot.

NOT this: no --kind flag, no message envelope, no second channel, no session-id tracking, no SessionStart/SessionEnd. The spec rejected those; an earlier plan revision had them and was rewritten.

Plan tasks (6): 1 pure slot src/agent_state.rs; 2 hook_event on the title pipe src/title_notify.rs; 3 installer derives the event set from both toggles src/agent_hooks.rs; 4 setting agent_state_badges (default false), install trigger, GUI apply (src/main.rs, src/terminal.rs, src/wm.rs); 5 panel badges (src/wm.rs, src/panel.rs); 6 live verification (needs the user), docs/agent-state.md, glossary, banner the stale foreman-agent-state-campaign skill, delete the plan.

Hard rules: zero bytes written into any Session; GUI only try_recv; messages carry event name + IDs, never prompt or tool text except the naming prompt; Claude/Codex hooks async; a reinstall never moves a handler (Codex keys trust by position); turning state off removes the state hooks. Read the plan Review Focus section first (huge PostToolUse payloads, another provider inside the pane, subagent events, reinstall order, Codex PostToolUse after Interrupt).

Gate: cargo build --target-dir target/agent; cargo test --target-dir target/agent. Never Stop-Process foreman.

Unblocks card gmm453 (idle-aware chat delivery), which consumes the AgentStateSlot this builds.
